name: zones_t11_get_lots_in_cell_rect
description: Conformance test 11 (GetLotsInCellRect, §8.3 slot 7). Lot A is 1 × 1 at (2, 2) (token 0x1000), lot B is 2 × 2 at (3, 2) (token 0x1001). originOnly = false: x outer, z inner; a lot is appended when it differs from the lot at (x, z-1) and from (x-1, z), both looked up inside the clamped rectangle. A first appears at (2,2) (neighbours null) -> appended; B first appears at (3,2) -> appended; at (3,3) B equals its (3,2) neighbour -> not appended. So [A, B], count 2. originOnly = true: z outer, x inner, lots whose origin is the cell -> A's origin (2,2) before B's (3,2) -> [A, B].
